sentences.text: Lithuania -LRB- UK and US : -LSB- lɪθuː ` eɪniə -RSB- , Lietuva -LSB- lʲɪɛtʊˈvɐ -RSB- -RRB- , officially the Republic of Lithuania -LRB- -LSB- Lietuvos Respublika , links = no -RSB- -RRB- , is a country in Northern Europe .	Northern Europe	Northern Europe

One of the three Baltic states , it is situated along the southeastern shore of the Baltic Sea , to the east of Sweden and Denmark .	Baltic states	Baltic states	Baltic Sea	Baltic Sea	Sweden	Sweden	Denmark	Denmark

It is bordered by Latvia to the north , Belarus to the east and south , Poland to the south , and Kaliningrad Oblast -LRB- a Russian exclave -RRB- to the southwest .	Latvia	Latvia	Belarus	Belarus	Poland	Poland	Kaliningrad Oblast	Kaliningrad Oblast	exclave	Enclave and exclave
Lithuania has an estimated population of 2.8 million people , and its capital and largest city is Vilnius .	Vilnius	Vilnius
Lithuanians are a Baltic people .	Lithuanians	Lithuanians	Baltic people	Baltic people

The official language , Lithuanian , along with Latvian , is one of only two living languages in the Baltic branch of the Indo-European language family .	Lithuanian	Lithuanian language	Latvian	Latvian language	Baltic branch	Baltic languages	Indo-European	Indo-European languages
For centuries , the southeastern shores of the Baltic Sea were inhabited by various Baltic tribes .	Baltic Sea	Baltic Sea	Baltic tribes	Balts

In the 1230s , the Lithuanian lands were united by Mindaugas , the King of Lithuania , and the first unified Lithuanian state , the Kingdom of Lithuania , was created on 6 July 1253 .	Lithuanian	Lithuanian language	Mindaugas	Mindaugas	Kingdom of Lithuania	Kingdom of Lithuania

During the 14th century , the Grand Duchy of Lithuania was the largest country in Europe ; present-day Lithuania , Belarus , Ukraine , and parts of Poland and Russia were the territories of the Grand Duchy .	Russia	Russia	Belarus	Belarus	Poland	Poland	Grand Duchy of Lithuania	Grand Duchy of Lithuania

With the Lublin Union of 1569 , Lithuania and Poland formed a voluntary two-state union , the Polish -- Lithuanian Commonwealth .	Lithuanian	Lithuanian language	Poland	Poland	Lublin Union	Lublin Union

The Commonwealth lasted more than two centuries , until neighboring countries systematically dismantled it from 1772 -- 95 , with the Russian Empire annexing most of Lithuania 's territory .	systematically dismantled	Partitions of Poland	Russian Empire	Russian Empire

As World War I neared its end , Lithuania 's Act of Independence was signed on 16 February 1918 , declaring the founding of the modern Republic of Lithuania .	Independence	History of Lithuania	World War I	World War I	Act of Independence	Act of Independence of Lithuania

In the midst of the Second World War , Lithuania was first occupied by the Soviet Union and then by Nazi Germany .	Germany	Germany	Soviet Union	State Council of the Soviet Union	Second World War	Second World War	occupied by the Soviet Union	Soviet occupation of the Baltic states (1940)	Nazi Germany	Occupation of Lithuania by Nazi Germany

As World War II neared its end and the Germans retreated , the Soviet Union reoccupied Lithuania .	Germans	Baltic Germans	Soviet Union	State Council of the Soviet Union	Soviet Union reoccupied Lithuania	Soviet occupation of the Baltic states (1944)

On 11 March 1990 , a year before the formal dissolution of the Soviet Union , Lithuania became the first Soviet republic to declare itself independent , resulting in the restoration of an independent State of Lithuania .	Soviet Union	State Council of the Soviet Union	dissolution of the Soviet Union	dissolution of the Soviet Union	Soviet republic	Republics of the Soviet Union	the restoration of an independent State of Lithuania	Act of the Re-Establishment of the State of Lithuania

Lithuania is a member of the European Union , the Council of Europe , a full member of the Eurozone , Schengen Agreement and NATO .	European Union	European Union	Council of Europe	Council of Europe	Eurozone	Eurozone	Schengen Agreement	Schengen Agreement	NATO	NATO
It is also a member of the Nordic Investment Bank , and part of Nordic-Baltic cooperation of Northern European countries .	Nordic Investment Bank	Nordic Investment Bank	Nordic-Baltic	NB8
The United Nations Human Development Index lists Lithuania as a `` very high human development '' country .	United Nations	United Nations	Human Development Index	Human Development Index

Lithuania has been among the fastest growing economies in the European Union and is ranked 21st in the world in the Ease of Doing Business Index .	European Union	European Union	Ease of Doing Business Index	Ease of Doing Business Index
